description: Externalized ticker -> CUSIP map for the LTHCS Institutional Confidence pillar (Tier 3 #13 Phase 1). Multiple CUSIPs per ticker handle share classes / re-organizations. Since 2026-10-05 every active universe ticker carries a CUSIP verified against the SEC Official List of Section 13(f) Securities (see provenance); name_aliases are only consulted for a ticker that has no CUSIP (sec_13f._build_name_lookup).

name_aliases: the bank of new york mellon

sec_13f_list.note: Latest list on the SEC index page when fetched on 2026-10-05 (no 2026Q3 list posted yet).

sec_company_tickers.use: ticker -> CIK -> SEC company name, cross-checked against the list issuer name; EDGAR submissions/8-Ks for renames and spin-offs

provenance.user_agent: the generic SEC User-Agent fetch_market.py falls back to (SEC_UA); no personal contact
provenance.rule: An active ticker maps to the CUSIP of its listed common / ordinary / ADS line that is live (not *D*) on the latest list, matched by issuer name and share class and cross-checked against the SEC CIK name. A predecessor CUSIP is kept only when it was live on the previous quarter's list, so the two quarters the QoQ signal compares both match. Every CUSIP passes the check-digit test and no CUSIP is claimed by two active tickers.
